./docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml:396:      summary: "Defines a local-first evidence boundary with isolated legacy lanes, explicit fetch/egress consent, canonical hash-chained run receipts, optional operator-owned signing, and a generated trust package. JSON is authoritative; human reports are derived and hash-linked. Absolute paths, environment values, secrets, and source text are excluded by default. Evidence remains local until explicit purge; freshness and retention policy are visible. Payment-like detection is a best-effort classifier but a hard scope signal: suspected payment data pauses execution for owner review. PCI/SOC mappings answer procurement questions but make no certification claim. Negative tests cover egress, leakage, redaction, tampering, reproducibility, unsupported states, and stale vulnerability evidence."
./docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml:434:          value: "Trust boundaries: TB1 operator/CI invokes the local CLI host; TB2 host reads a content-addressed source snapshot and writes a separate working copy; TB3 legacy install/build/dev commands run in isolated pinned Node/container lanes with restricted filesystem and network; TB4 Playwright-controlled browser processes receive only synthetic local fixtures and loopback routes; TB5 immutable evidence outputs are written outside the mutable worktree; TB6 optional source/package/vulnerability fetch crosses the network only after explicit purpose-scoped consent; TB7 any future hosted service is a separate opt-in processor with its own endpoint, payload manifest, retention and receipt. Cache, working copy, browser profile, receipt store and trust-package store are distinct assets."
./docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml:439:          kind: design_inference_run_receipt_schema
./docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml:440:          value: "Canonical run JSON fields: schema/version; receipt_id; run status enum; tool name/version/build digest; host OS/arch/runtime; operator mode local|CI and pseudonymous actor ID; start/end observations; policy/config digest; consent events; input repository/archive/revision/content digest/license evidence; cache artifacts; legacy and target lane image/runtime/package-manager/lock digests; commands as normalized argv plus cwd token and exit/signal/duration; transformations with rule/version/input/output/diff digests; files changed as logical relative paths and hashes; manual steps/approvals; network policy and normalized attempted/allowed/blocked destinations; build artifacts and hashes; tests/journeys/mutations; unsupported/refused/skipped/failure reasons; redaction summary; child evidence hashes; output receipt/trust links; integrity envelope."
./docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml:446:          value: "Authoritative JSON uses an RFC 8785-compatible profile with UTF-8, duplicate-key rejection and schema validation. Hash SHA-256 over the canonical payload excluding the integrity envelope; envelope records algorithm, payload digest, schema digest, previous receipt digest and referenced artifact digests. Separate deterministic_core from observations such as timestamps/durations/host identity, so repeated equivalent runs can compare core digests without pretending the full execution envelope is byte-identical."
./docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml:449:          value: "Every receipt is hash-protected; signing is optional for local runs and mandatory for official CI/release trust packages once a project signing identity exists. Unsigned receipts explicitly say integrity=hash_only and authenticity=not_established. Versionless never creates or owns a durable default private key. Offline signing uses an operator-supplied encrypted local/hardware key and records public-key fingerprint only; enterprise CI should use operator-owned KMS/HSM or approved OIDC keyless identity. Keyless Sigstore is opt-in egress and cannot be called in offline mode. Verification policy, trusted identities/keys, revocation/rotation owner and signature bundle are recorded."
./docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml:467:          value: "Enterprise questions mapped without attestation claims: 'What ran and changed?' run receipt/provenance/diffs; 'Did source leave the device?' deny-by-default network evidence and consent log; 'Can evidence be altered?' canonical hashes/chains/signatures; 'What components/licenses/known vulnerabilities exist?' SBOM/license/OSV/KEV with freshness and gaps; 'Who approved exceptions/manual work?' actor/approval records; 'Can we reproduce it?' immutable inputs, lane digests, commands and deterministic core; 'How is sensitive data handled?' prohibited-input policy, classifier stop signal, redaction and retention; 'What controls relate to PCI payment-page risk?' script inventory/digests, network destinations, browser tamper/mutation evidence and explicit scope-owner review; 'What relates to SOC 2-oriented review?' security, availability, processing-integrity, confidentiality and privacy evidence with owners and operating-period gaps. None is a PCI AOC/ROC, SOC 2 report, certification, legal opinion or assessor conclusion."
